Radico Khaitan Limited (RKL) has informed the Exchange that the Company has entered into a distribution agreement with Highland Distillers, part of The Edrington Group, Scotland, to market and sell prestigious brands of scotch whisky viz. THE FAMOUS GROUSE, THE MACALLAN and HIGHLAND PARK, as well as extensions from THE FAMOUS GROUSE stable. RKL has a widespread and strong distribution network covering the entire country including those states, which have a policy to allow the sale of foreign liquor. The recent relaxation in the liquor policy of some of the State Governments to sell imported brands in retail outlets has created a huge potential for scotch whiskies in India. RKL aims to tap this potential with this tie up. This Agreement envisages the distribution of the above said brands through CSD canteens and in the open markets. The Agreement will also encompass the supply of bulk scotch from Highland Distillers for the Radico Khaitan Ltd. portfolio for blending its Indian Made Foreign Liquor brands. The Company has further informed that Radico Khaitan Ltd. already has in place the exclusive rights for the distribution of E&J Gallo wines of California and "Becks" beer of Germany in its bouquet.
